description: Nepal's National Statistics Office runs a results portal for the 2021 National Population and Housing Census with a census dataset page of plain CSV tables. The household tables count households by type of foundation (mud bonded, cement bonded, reinforced concrete with pillars, wooden pillars), outer wall, roof and floor material, drinking water source, cooking fuel, lighting source (grid electricity, solar, kerosene, biogas), toilet type and amenities. Each file carries province, district and local level codes and names, with rows for the nation, 7 provinces, 77 districts and 753 rural and urban municipalities. A separate house listing section gives workbooks with the number of building structures by main use, including health, educational, government and industrial buildings, and by number of floors and government grant; a table by building age is listed but no file link for it was found. Coverage is national. Format and access: free CSV and XLSX, no registration; national and provincial report PDFs sit on the same portal. Licence: no licence or terms were found on the portal. Caveats: the portal home page loads figures by script; a second census site (censusnepal.cbs.gov.np) failed TLS name checks. Simulation uses: foundation and wall types by municipality for earthquake and landslide exposure, and solar versus grid lighting for electrification planning. Related records: the HRRP Nepal housing reconstruction 4W dataset.
